name: Gallery Image Lifecycle & Viewer Hotfix
changes: Repairs stale article indices in gallery actions using stable article identity.
Adds a bounded 15-second loading watchdog for image elements missing load/error events.
Detects visible image cards with no image or loader after a grace period and removes them from browsing.
Registers viewer full-image error handling before URL assignment and suppresses verified decoder-failed images.
Runs integrity sweeps when Continuous browsing appends cards.
regression_guards: Preserves v3.7.11 visual corruption detection and its test.
Preserves v3.7.9 bounded preview recovery and v3.7.8 Image Sets ON/OFF settings.
Preserves NNTP, native thumbnail decoder, downloads, Automation and updater.
preserved: SABnzbd 5.1.2 and SABCTools 9.6.3; no downloads or Usenet posts are deleted.
